en: Job 5

p.src: 1  “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?

en: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
u.src: 1  “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?

p.src: 2  For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.

en: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.
u.src: 2  For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.

p.src: 3  I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

en: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
u.src: 3  I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

p.src: 4  His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,

en: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,
u.src: 4  His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,

p.src: 5  whose harvest the hungry eat up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.

en: whose harvest the hungry eat up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.
u.src: 5  whose harvest the hungry eat up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.

p.src: 6  For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;

en: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;
u.src: 6  For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;

p.src: 7  but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

en: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
u.src: 7  but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

p.src: 8  “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,

en: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,
u.src: 8  “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,

p.src: 9  who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;

en: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;
u.src: 9  who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;

p.src: 10  who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;

en: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;
u.src: 10  who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;

p.src: 11  so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.

en: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.
u.src: 11  so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.

p.src: 12  He frustrates the plans of the crafty, so that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.

en: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, so that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.
u.src: 12  He frustrates the plans of the crafty, so that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.

p.src: 13  He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

en: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
u.src: 13  He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

p.src: 14  They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.

en: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.
u.src: 14  They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.

p.src: 15  But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.

en: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.
u.src: 15  But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.

p.src: 16  So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.

en: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.
u.src: 16  So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.

p.src: 17  “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.

en: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
u.src: 17  “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.

p.src: 18  For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.

en: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.
u.src: 18  For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.

p.src: 19  He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.

en: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.
u.src: 19  He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.

p.src: 20  In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.

en: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.
u.src: 20  In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.

p.src: 21  You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.

en: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.
u.src: 21  You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.

p.src: 22  You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.

en: You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.
u.src: 22  You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.

p.src: 23  For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.

en: For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.
u.src: 23  For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.

p.src: 24  You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.

en: You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.
u.src: 24  You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.

p.src: 25  You will know also that your offspring will be great, your offspring as the grass of the earth.

en: You will know also that your offspring will be great, your offspring as the grass of the earth.
u.src: 25  You will know also that your offspring will be great, your offspring as the grass of the earth.

en: 5:25 or, seed

p.src: 26  You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.

en: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.
u.src: 26  You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.

p.src: 27  Behold, we have researched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”

en: Behold, we have researched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”
u.src: 27  Behold, we have researched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”
